description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS S3 Regional Endpoint, managing configuration related to endpoint types in the AWS PHP SDK.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Represents configuration options for regional endpoint settings in AWS S3 SDK, including endpoint type and fallback status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Configuration with endpoint type and optional fallback flag, validating the endpoint type parameter.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type, either 'legacy' or 'regional'.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration data as an array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Returns whether fallback mode is enabled.
